question: In MS PowerPoint 2019, which of the following tabs must you first select to access the 'Open' option for loading a saved PowerPoint file?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**File tab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **MS PowerPoint 2019**, the **File tab** provides access to the backstage view, where you can manage file-related tasks such as opening, saving, printing, and sharing.
 
• The **Open** option is available under the File tab, allowing users to browse and load saved **PowerPoint presentations**.
 
• The File tab is located in the **top left corner** of the interface, making it easily accessible.
 
• When you click on the File tab, you enter the **backstage view**, which is dedicated to managing the presentation as a whole rather than working on individual slides.
 
• The backstage view includes options such as **New**, **Open**, **Save**, **Save As**, **Print**, **Share**, and **Export**, among others.
 
• Using the Open option, you can access presentations stored in various locations, including **local drives, external storage devices, and cloud-based services** like OneDrive.
 
• The File tab is a common feature across all **Microsoft Office applications**, ensuring a consistent user experience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Design tab**__

 __
 
• The **Design tab** is used to modify the **appearance** of slides in a presentation.
 
• It allows users to apply **themes, variants, and slide backgrounds** to enhance visual appeal.
 
• This tab does not contain file management options like opening or saving presentations.
 
 
 
• **Insert tab**__
 __
 
• The **Insert tab** is used to add various **elements** to slides, such as images, tables, charts, videos, and shapes.
 
• This tab enhances the content of slides but does not deal with presentation-level operations like opening files.
 
 
 
• **Home tab**__
 
 
• The **Home tab** provides basic formatting and editing tools like **text alignment, font settings, and slide layout options**.
 
• It is primarily used for slide-level tasks and does not include options related to managing presentation files.
